DBG.last_query: SELECT DISTINCT x.* FROM (SELECT 'avpn' t, o.id did, o.id oid, m.meta_value nr, COALESCE(o.date_completed_gmt,o.date_paid_gmt,o.date_created_gmt) d, o.total_amount s, o.status st, o.billing_email em, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(a.last_name,'')) kl, p.meta_value pdf FROM gaj6_wc_orders_meta m JOIN gaj6_wc_orders o ON o.id=m.order_id AND o.type='shop_order' LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_order_addresses a ON a.order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='billing' LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_orders_meta p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.meta_key='_petshop_completed_pdf' WHERE m.meta_key='_petshop_avpn_number' UNION ALL SELECT 'iapv' t, o.id did, o.id oid, m.meta_value nr, o.date_created_gmt d, o.total_amount s, o.status st, o.billing_email em, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(a.last_name,'')) kl, p.meta_value pdf FROM gaj6_wc_orders_meta m JOIN gaj6_wc_orders o ON o.id=m.order_id AND o.type='shop_order' LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_order_addresses a ON a.order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='billing' LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_orders_meta p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.meta_key='_petshop_order_pdf' WHERE m.meta_key='_petshop_iapv_number' UNION ALL SELECT 'kr' t, r.id did, o.id oid, m.meta_value nr, r.date_created_gmt d, r.total_amount s, o.status st, o.billing_email em, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(a.last_name,'')) kl, p.meta_value pdf FROM gaj6_wc_orders_meta m JOIN gaj6_wc_orders r ON r.id=m.order_id AND r.type='shop_order_refund' JOIN gaj6_wc_orders o ON o.id=r.parent_order_id LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_order_addresses a ON a.order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='billing' LEFT JOIN gaj6_wc_orders_meta p ON p.order_id=r.id AND p.meta_key='_petshop_kravpn_pdf' WHERE m.meta_key='_petshop_kravpn_number') x WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY x.d DESC, x.nr DESC
